The console has 'PS4' and 'SONY' logos visible on the front, confirming it is a PS4.
The console appears to be the 'fat' model, judging by its size and shape.
There is visible dust and minor scuffs on the console surface.
Photo 1 shows a hand holding the black controller, with the console in the background. The console's front panel is visible, showing the disc slot and USB ports.
Photo 2 shows the same setup as photo 0, with the hand now holding the black controller over the console. The 'PS4' logo is visible on the right side.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
No screen or gameplay is shown, so functionality cannot be confirmed.
The seller claims it is 'hacked with latest games' — this cannot be verified from photos.
